checks.required_behavior: The partner-confirmed band must be read only for the underwriting/credit decision, not for marketing selection or delivery.

The only read of c['confirmed'] is in drain's score branch (0132), where band=c['confirmed'] or c['income'] feeds the automatic underwriting decision (0133-0135). No other consumer of confirmed exists in the supplied source.

anchors.explanation: Partner band enters cases.confirmed, purpose-bound to underwriting.

output.summary: Static review of the supplied source shows the partner-confirmed band (cases.confirmed) is written only by 'verify' as underwriting input and read only in drain's automatic score branch. Marketing audience selection (eligible_campaign) and delivery (drain promotion branch, action promotion) rely solely on owner identity, promotions/objection choices and case eligibility (restricted, stage); promotion content and offer payloads omit the band. No path uses the confirmed band for marketing selection or delivery, consistent with the purpose-limitation predicate. No code was executed.
